_README: Transcription fixes for your talking-head videos. Lives at the REPO ROOT: it is pipeline plumbing, not a look, and four consumers read it (export-transcript.py, scan-transcript.py, and both caption build.py files), so it belongs to none of them. Despite fixing words you may also see in captions, this is NOT a captions file: it is applied ONCE to the canonical transcript (outputs/<job>.transcript.json) at pipeline step 2, when rough-cut splices it, so the fix flows to graphics AND captions AND every format — long-form inherits it while never getting a burned-in caption at all. The raw transcript/words.json is left untouched. 'auto' = whole-word, case-insensitive replacements applied silently, matched ONE WORD AT A TIME — keys must be single-token (a multi-word key like 'open ai' can never match). 'flag' = ambiguous words (real word OR a mishear) PRINTED for you to eyeball in context each run. For a one-off fix on a single video, drop projects/<job>/corrections.local.json (same {auto,flag} shape) — it merges on top. Override the path with $TRANSCRIPT_CORRECTIONS. Add your own brand and product names here; grow the file as new mistranscriptions show up.
_NOTE_es: 2026-09-25 · Spanish speakers: 'Claude' is often transcribed as clot / clod / claud (auto-fixed: not real words) or as 'cloud' / 'Claudio' (real words, so only FLAGGED for review — 'cloud' may genuinely mean the cloud). 'Groove' is a frequent mishear of 'Grok' (flagged). 'Claude Code' needs no multi-word key: each token is fixed on its own.
